cases.prompt: Our plant (fictional) just passed acceptance for a group of newly connected machines. The OD team will leave next month. How do we make sure our own people can run and fix this?
cases.expected_output: Checks readiness first (acceptance, data path to the machine, sign-off answered, infrastructure live). Proposes a minimum module set for a machine wave using roles, not names. Every module ends in a hands-on form on the real screen or machine. Says the plant owner confirms each competence with evidence. Says no critical skill may rest on one person.

cases.prompt: We have a new Andon board on line 3 and one key user who knows how it works. Draft what we need so the shift leads can use it without calling anyone.
cases.expected_output: Fills a package and a competence checklist for one plant and one solution. Marks durations, dates and trainers as unknown instead of inventing them. Flags the single person who knows as a risk to be reported to the OD lead via COP. Does not mark any competence as confirmed.

cases.prompt: The dashboard is still in acceptance testing but the plant wants the training next week on the demo environment to save time. Please prepare it.
cases.expected_output: Says not to train before acceptance and not on a demo environment. States that readiness is not met and no session is scheduled. Reports the reason to the OD lead. May still prepare a draft package marked as not ready.

cases.prompt: Three months after go-live nobody opens the dashboard. Why is that and how do we get people to use it?
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is an adoption diagnosis for a stalled use case, which belongs to the handover skill. Does not draft a training package first. May mention that training is only one possible cause.

should_trigger: Draft a training package for the plant that is taking over the new integrated machines.
What must our key user be able to do before the OD team hands over?
Make a competence checklist for the shift leads for the new dashboard.
How do we avoid that only one person at the plant knows how this works?
should_not_trigger: Run the acceptance test for the new machine connection.
Why is the utilization of our dashboard zero after go-live?
Write a training course on lean manufacturing for new hires.
Which route should we use to connect this machine?
